text: L-type monosaccharide L-fucose binds DC-SIGN and activates NF-kB in mouse macrophage, resulting in immune regulation and anti-inflammatory cytokine reduction.
D-type monosaccharide D-glucose weakly modulates MAPK and shows limited anti-inflammatory effects in vitro.
Sulfated L-type monosaccharide enhances DC-SIGN mediated signaling pathway and supports immune regulation phenotype.
